This list only shrinks: lint:tenant-matrix-ratchet pins its length. A route that a fixture now covers must leave the list; a route that cannot be driven by id (a token is the credential, a public render) keeps a reason that says so.

routes.PUT /api/compliance/iso/docs/:slug: the key is the caller's own organisation plus the slug (ismsDocStore): every organisation keeps its own document under the same policy slug, so the slug names the caller's document, never another organisation's
